runtime.wayland_protocol_global: xdg_activation_v1 version 1 (present in the lsi session)

files.fact: QWaylandWindow::requestActivateWindow forwards to the shell surface when one exists.

facts: QWaylandXdgSurface::requestActivate uses an existing or XDG_ACTIVATION_TOKEN when present.
Otherwise it requests an xdg activation token using the last input device serial and activates the target surface when the token arrives.
The compositor session exposes xdg_activation_v1, so this route is available in principle.

interpretation: In installed Qt 6.8.2, QWindow::requestActivate is not an unconditional Wayland no-op: QtWayland can request an xdg activation token from the last input serial when the compositor advertises xdg_activation_v1. This supports keeping the R596 candidate for user evaluation, but does not prove that activating Kicker's popup fixes keyboard focus or prevents hover deactivation.
next: Use the user's post-reload observation to confirm whether search typing and category hover now work.
If either symptom remains, instrument the popup active/focus windows and the Kicker submenu deactivation path before revising R596.
